LIFE SKILLS WORKSHEETS · AGES 4–5

Life Skills & Good Habits worksheets — printables for little hands.

Everyday skills on real activity sheets: wash your hands, tidy up, be kind, move your body, the magic words and asking for help. Download the original sheet, print it, or do it on screen in Class 32 first.

Wash Your Hands WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsClean hands before eating, a toothbrush for every child and a breakfast that is really healthy. View Worksheet → Tidy Up WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsEvery toy has a home — teddy, car, ball and blocks go back where they belong. View Worksheet → Be Kind WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsKind words, feeling faces and taking turns — the everyday habits of a good friend. View Worksheet → Move Your Body WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsRun, jump and stretch — spot safe movement, match the poses and choose active play. View Worksheet → Please and Thank You WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsThe magic words — please, thank you and excuse me, matched to the right moment. View Worksheet → Ask for Help WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsAsking a trusted grown-up is a skill — practise the words and pick the right helper. View Worksheet → Get Ready WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsDressing all by yourself, clothes to the right body area and a morning in the right order. View Worksheet → Pack Up WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsBooks, pencils and water bottles to the right pocket — getting ready for school like a pro. View Worksheet → Eat Well WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsEvery-day foods and sometimes foods, good table habits and one healthy plate to fill. View Worksheet → Stop, Look, Go WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsTraffic light meanings, waiting at the crossing and choosing the safe place to cross. View Worksheet → Bedtime Routine WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsTeeth, pajamas and a story in the right order — and ticking the calm way to end the day. View Worksheet → Stay Safe WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsSafe choices at home — outlets, knives, stairs — and matching every object to its safe use. View Worksheet → Help at Home WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsChores matched to their tools, kind helping hands and one job you can really do. View Worksheet → Care for Plants WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsWater and sunlight for growing things, gentle hands and one new leaf to draw. View Worksheet → Listen Well WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsEars ready, follow the instruction the first time — clap, sit, raise your hand. View Worksheet → My Body, My Rules WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsAsking before touching, comfortable personal space and naming feelings — the foundations of body safety. View Worksheet → Be Gentle WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsSoft hands for animals, each pet item to its job, and the right food and water to choose. View Worksheet → Care for Clothes WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsClean or dirty, every item to its place, and a shirt to draw on the washing line. View Worksheet → Dress for Weather WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsRaincoats for rain, mittens for snow, shorts for sun — matching the day to the clothes. View Worksheet → Calm Down WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsNaming big feelings, choosing a calm-down action and finding the helpful breath. View Worksheet → Keep It Clean WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsRubbish in the bin, paper-plastic-glass to the right recycling, and care for nature. View Worksheet → Wait Your Turn WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsCalm waiting, the turn-taking order on the slide and sharing without grabbing. View Worksheet → Use Kind Words WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsSolving small problems kindly — calm talking, helpful actions and one friendly speech bubble. View Worksheet → Helping People WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsDoctors, firefighters, teachers and mail carriers — the right helper for every situation. View Worksheet → Tell the Truth WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsHonest words in tricky moments — broken vase, stolen cookie, low grade — and owning your mistakes. View Worksheet → Take Care WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsGentle hands for books, every school supply to its place, and careful use we can tick. View Worksheet → My Daily Routine WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsMorning, afternoon and night in order — and a clock showing morning to draw. View Worksheet → Play Fair WorksheetAges 4–5Class 32Life SkillsSharing the game, fair choices when things go wrong and shaking hands at the end.
